  "phoneNote": "The playful lido aesthetic is charming, but on the first screen the circular lifebuoy graphic is awkwardly cut off at the bottom and the red awning motif feels more like an ice-cream shop than a swimming school.",
  "desktopNote": "The oversized display headline pushes the primary call-to-action buttons below the fold on the first screen, and the basic facts (when, where, who) are repeated four separate times down the page.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline size and top awning height so the 'Pokličite nas' button and 'Pišite nam' link are clearly visible above the fold.",
    "Tighten the vertical spacing in the mobile hero so the lifebuoy photo graphic isn't awkwardly sliced right at the top edge by the bottom bar.",
    "Consolidate the repeated 'Kdaj / Kje / Za koga' details—keep the charming ticket stubs, but replace the identical FAQ items with more useful parent information."
  ]
}
